market_holds: Spot about $18.3 at 14:26 ET on 2026-11-18, down 5.9% on the day on about 7k ADS (Yahoo 1h bars). The sealed baseline has 18.87 at 18:08 UTC, -2.7% over 5d, +2.0% over 20d, 8.8% below the 52w high and +124% off the 52w low. The stock roughly doubled in 2026 (weekly closes from 10.75 on 2026-05-01 to 20.09 on 2026-10-30). It sits at the average analyst target of $19.89 (7 analysts, Strong Buy; the last action listed is Citi raising its target to $22 on 2026-08-24) and a forward P/E of about 54 (stockanalysis, 2026-11-18). There is no usable option chain (ATM spread 117% of mid). The 20d realised vol of 36% gives a 2.3% deadband. Consensus is thin and its units are muddled: Chartmill shows Q3 revenue at 1.669B, which reads as RMB, cut 9.4% over three months, and EPS of '0.22', where its FY figure of '1.90 USD' matches stockanalysis's RMB 1.88 non-GAAP, so the units look like RMB. Treat the EPS bar as unreliable. FY2026 revenue consensus is RMB 6.4B against H1 of 2.815B, which implies H2 up about 11%. That number looks stale. Management gave no numeric guide. The only statement was that H2 profitability and cash flow would improve further (Q2 release, 2026-08-20). The last four reactions measured to about 13:00 ET from the prior close: Q3'25 -6.5% (profit miss), Q4'25 -3.7% (despite an EPS beat and ads +37%), Q1'26 -5.6% (EPS miss), Q2'26 +1.4% (a big EPS beat with a 6% revenue miss; it added +8.8% the next day, outside the window). Positioning: Orbis holds 19.7% of the ADS class (13G/A, as of 2026-09-30, down from 20.1%). NetEase holds control. The President sold RSU-vested ADSs at about $14.97 on 2026-09-09.
view: The stock trades on profit, not revenue. In Q2, revenue missed by about 6% while EPS was about three times consensus, and the stock held up. Q3 sets up the same way, with more risk on the headline. My own arithmetic from the segment comps: learning services up about 18% on an easy comp (Q3'25 -16.2%), online marketing down about 13% against Q3'25's +51% comp with no new domestic NetEase launch in Q3'26 (ANANTA is set for Jan 2027), and smart devices down about 40% (industry learning-tablet units -30.8% in Q3, and Youdao is pulling back from tablets). That gives revenue of about RMB 1.55B, -5% YoY and about 7% below the 1.669B consensus. That would probably be the first YoY revenue decline in this run. Operating profit should look very strong against Q3'25's RMB 28.3M, probably above RMB 100M on a higher gross margin, and a record or near-record quarter is plausible. If the EPS consensus really is low, a large EPS beat is likely. The record says that is not enough inside this window. The Q4'25 beat still fell 3.7% by 13:00, and the Q2'26 beat gained only 1.4% by 13:00. This is now an 'AI' stock at about 54x forward earnings, sitting at its target. Ads shrinking, devices collapsing and AI subscription growth slowing (+70% in Q1, +20% in Q2) give sellers material. Against that, the stock already fell about 6% into the print on almost no volume, and China ADRs were weak all week (KWEB about -5% over 5d). That partly lowers the bar and could mean-revert. On balance it tilts slightly down. The tilt is not strong enough to bet on, because the EPS bar cannot be pinned down and a profit beat has been the decisive line before.
unpriced: Possibly this: revenue and full-year estimates look too high relative to my segment arithmetic (ads facing a +51% comp, devices falling with the industry), and a print showing revenue down YoY could reset the growth narrative of a stock that has doubled. I cannot show that the price does not hold it. Estimates were already cut 9.4%, the Q2 revenue miss was forgiven, and the EPS consensus is too unclear to call a profit surprise either way.

recommendation.reason: Revenue will probably miss and decline YoY, but this stock has traded on profit, and profit should look strong against a very easy Q3'25 comp. The EPS bar cannot be established from public aggregators because units and figures conflict, so the profit line, which decides the reaction, is a coin flip relative to expectations. Three of the last four prints fell by 13:00 ET, which gives a mild down tilt, but the 6% pre-print slide on thin volume offsets part of it.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: AI subscription sales re-accelerating well above +20% YoY, or online marketing returning to growth, together with a record operating profit, would make the print read as an AI-growth beat rather than a shrinking-revenue margin story.

self_critique: The Q2 pattern, revenue miss plus a big EPS beat, may simply repeat. Q3 is the seasonal high for learning services, and a record operating profit against a RMB28M comp would make a strong headline. The stock also gave up about 6% today on almost no volume before the print, so a beat could easily send it back above $19 by 13:00 in a tape this thin. My down tilt rests on a small-sample reaction pattern and on revenue arithmetic the market may already discount.
approach_notes: P6 (find the line the stock trades on) and P4 (prove priced in) did the most work. The reaction history showed profit is the line, and the unclear consensus is why no call is made. Freshest-data-first (P3) was hard here because Chinese consumer and e-commerce data for Youdao's own products was not findable in the time available.
